title: Claude Code Agent Tier Routing (T2 howto)
desc: Execution detail for claude-code-agent-tier-routing: the exact invocation per tier (Haiku survey, Codex/Agent.cmd refactor, Sonnet inline, Opus judgment, Triad planning, Agent.cmd light/agy models), brief-guard format, and parallel non-conflicting dispatch rules.
steps: HAIKU survey (read-only): Agent(subagent_type:'Explore', model:'haiku', run_in_background:true, prompt). Pace-EXEMPT even when root is hard-blocked. Use for grep/read/survey/git-diff verification.
CODEX / Agent.cmd refactor: wkcodex.sh for source splits and multi-file edits; Agent.cmd --model X for non-Claude models. NEVER use Haiku for code SPLITS (silent content drop).

SONNET = default inline work (no agent). OPUS = Agent(model:'opus', run_in_background:true) for judgment / architecture / catching agent flaws. TRIAD = wkappbot ask triad for planning and hard ambiguity.

Agent.cmd MODELS: --model lite (Gemini Flash Lite), --model agy (Antigravity), --model haiku/sonnet/opus. Agent.cmd has an EXTRA tier-gate the Agent tool lacks: it requires claude-code-agent-tier-routing itself to be 3-tier split (-howto + -ref) with Get-WkTierScore >= 80, else it hard-blocks ALL Agent.cmd dispatch.

BRIEF-GUARD (every Agent/Agent.cmd dispatch): include 3 wkappbot skill read references PLUS the labels Goal / Files / Approach / Constraints / Exit as EXACT words with NO parenthetical between a label and its colon.

PARALLEL NON-CONFLICTING dispatch: partition work by FILE so two agents never edit the same file; give each a UNIQUE wkbuild tag; instruct 'if build lock, wait 60s and retry once' (parallel edits are safe, parallel builds collide). next:claude-code-agent-tier-routing for the routing decision rules. cluster:claude-code-agent-tier-routing-ref for history.
